answer_1.quote: In machine translation (MT) gender bias has received significant attention, also in the public domain.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are machine-translated sentences in Italian, Spanish, or German from English source sentences, which are then post-edited by participants to ensure correct gender marking (feminine or masculine) for human referents.

answer_2.quote: We use the set of contrastive F/M target references to compute gender-related performance differences with BLEU, i.e. BLEU F - BLEU M.

answer_4.quote: 88 participants post-edited MT outputs to ensure either feminine or masculine gender translation.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were instructed to carry out a light PE - i.e. targeting only essential fixes to adjust the overall quality of the translation - with a focus on ensuring either feminine or masculine translation for human referents, based on provided gender information.
